profit_sharing_ratio.formula: Profit Share = Total Profit × Partner's Ratio / Total Ratio
profit_sharing_ratio.use_when: Partners share profit in a given ratio

interest_on_capital.formula: Interest on Capital = Capital × Rate × Time / 100

interest_on_drawings.formula: Interest on Drawings = Drawings × Rate × Time / 100
interest_on_drawings.use_when: Interest is charged on partner's drawings

average_profit.formula: Average Profit = Sum of Profits / Number of Years

goodwill_average_profit.formula: Goodwill = Average Profit × Number of Years' Purchase

super_profit.formula: Super Profit = Average Profit − Normal Profit

normal_profit.formula: Normal Profit = Capital Employed × Normal Rate of Return / 100

goodwill_super_profit.formula: Goodwill = Super Profit × Number of Years' Purchase

capitalised_value.formula: Capitalised Value = Average Profit × 100 / Normal Rate of Return

goodwill_capitalisation.formula: Goodwill = Capitalised Value − Actual Capital Employed

capitalised_super_profit.formula: Goodwill = Super Profit × 100 / Normal Rate of Return

sacrificing_ratio.formula: Sacrificing Ratio = Old Ratio − New Ratio
sacrificing_ratio.use_when: Calculating sacrifice made by old partners

new_ratio.formula: New Ratio = Old Ratio − Sacrificing Share

premium_for_goodwill.formula: New Partner's Share of Goodwill = Total Goodwill × New Partner's Share

gaining_ratio.formula: Gaining Ratio = New Ratio − Old Ratio

retiring_partner_goodwill.formula: Retiring Partner's Share of Goodwill = Total Goodwill × Retiring Partner's Share

profit_until_death.formula: Profit up to Death = Estimated Annual Profit × Months Worked / 12

share_of_profit.formula: Deceased Partner's Share = Profit up to Death × Profit Sharing Ratio

sacrificing_ratio.formula: Sacrificing Ratio = Old Ratio − New Ratio

gaining_ratio.formula: Gaining Ratio = New Ratio − Old Ratio

realisation_profit.formula: Profit on Realisation = Credit of Realisation A/c − Debit of Realisation A/c

realisation_loss.formula: Loss on Realisation = Debit of Realisation A/c − Credit of Realisation A/c

partner_realisation_share.formula: Partner's Share = Realisation Profit/Loss × Partner's Profit Sharing Ratio

share_application.formula: Application Money = Number of Shares Applied × Application Amount per Share

share_allotment.formula: Allotment Money = Number of Shares Allotted × Allotment Amount per Share

share_call.formula: Call Money = Number of Shares × Call Amount per Share

securities_premium.formula: Securities Premium = Number of Shares × Premium per Share

amount_forfeited.formula: Amount Forfeited = Amount Received on Forfeited Shares

capital_reserve.formula: Capital Reserve = Forfeited Amount − Discount on Reissue
capital_reserve.use_when: Profit on reissue of forfeited shares

debenture_interest.formula: Debenture Interest = Face Value × Rate × Time / 100

premium_on_redemption.formula: Premium on Redemption = Redemption Value − Face Value

gross_profit.formula: Gross Profit = Revenue from Operations − Cost of Revenue

gross_loss.formula: Gross Loss = Cost of Revenue − Revenue from Operations

operating_profit.formula: Operating Profit = Gross Profit + Operating Income − Operating Expenses

net_profit.formula: Net Profit = Operating Profit + Non-operating Income − Non-operating Expenses

current_ratio.formula: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities

quick_ratio.formula: Quick Ratio = Quick Assets / Current Liabilities

debt_equity_ratio.formula: Debt Equity Ratio = Long-term Debt / Shareholders' Funds

gross_profit_ratio.formula: Gross Profit Ratio = Gross Profit / Revenue from Operations × 100

net_profit_ratio.formula: Net Profit Ratio = Net Profit / Revenue from Operations × 100

operating_ratio.formula: Operating Ratio = (Cost of Revenue + Operating Expenses) / Revenue from Operations × 100

operating_profit_ratio.formula: Operating Profit Ratio = Operating Profit / Revenue from Operations × 100

cash_from_operations.formula: Cash from Operating Activities = Net Profit before Tax + Non-cash Expenses + Non-operating Expenses − Non-operating Incomes ± Working Capital Changes
cash_from_operations.use_when: Indirect method of operating cash flow

working_capital_change.formula: Increase in Current Asset = Deduct; Decrease in Current Asset = Add; Increase in Current Liability = Add; Decrease in Current Liability = Deduct

net_change_cash.formula: Net Change in Cash = Operating Cash Flow + Investing Cash Flow + Financing Cash Flow
net_change_cash.use_when: Finding change in cash and cash equivalents

rules.asset: Increase in Asset is generally Debit; decrease is generally Credit
rules.liability: Increase in Liability is generally Credit; decrease is generally Debit
rules.capital: Increase in Capital is Credit; decrease in Capital is Debit
